description: A major update introducing playlist support, NSFW filtering, dedicated information pages, and broad UI/UX improvements across the platform.

logs.desc: Playlist functionality for the video player, allowing users to move between episodes using previous and next arrows in the top-left corner.
An NSFW filtering system for Anime, Movie, Webtoon, and Manga albums.
Total duration display for albums, showing the combined length of all episodes. Initial calculation may take a few seconds.
Dedicated information pages. Clicking cover art now opens a detailed info view instead of starting playback immediately, with playback available through the Episode 1 Play button.
A TypeScript-based language handler with Turkish support, laying the groundwork for additional languages in future updates.
A forum link in the navigation bar.
Dynamic content loading for the Featured page, with NSFW content automatically filtered based on 18+ age restrictions or explicit tags.
New TypeScript core modules: playerControls, videoPlayer, svgScripts, languageHandler, animeListerScript, sloganHandler, infoHandler, and playListHandler.
'animeIDs.json' in the '/public' directory for centralized anime ID management.
A standardized structure and design for version history and changelog entries.
Dynamic fetching for version logs to keep changelog content easier to update.
Store, What's New, and Forums links in the footer.
A global search bar in the primary navigation bar.
The video player sliders for a sleeker look and smoother feel.
The Hero sections for the Featured, Settings, and Landing pages.
The Store page UI/UX for a cleaner and more polished experience.
Navbar behavior so it transitions to a bottom-docked layout on smaller screens for improved mobile accessibility.
The language switcher location from the navigation bar to the footer.
The side navbar default state so it starts collapsed, maximizing the available content area.
The dark mode background color to true black (#000000).
The '/src/assets/animes/' directory for better asset organization.
Additional UI elements into reusable Astro components.
The footer with a more complete UI/UX update.
'Discover' to 'Featured' for algorithmically curated content. The new Discover page now serves as a high-performance filtering engine for advanced content search.
Animation stuttering on the loading screen.
Deprecated content wrappers to streamline the DOM structure.
Store, What's New, and Forums links from the main navigation bar.
'videoIds.json' from the '/public' directory.
A context-aware sidebar that changes based on the active page. This feature is currently in a demo and unstable state.
